pose: Directly facing the camera in a symmetrical, upright 'pillar' stance. Despite its natural low-slung tank-like build, the head is raised and positioned at the very top edge of the 1024px frame, with the front feet at the very bottom. The large forward-pointing shoulder spikes are angled inward toward the neck to stay within the 300px horizontal central corridor, ensuring no part of the armor is lost in the 340x140px crop.

character_details.expression: Signature friendly smirk; a gentle giant look.
character_details.eyes: Large, soulful, and expressive character eyes.
character_details.skin_texture: Smooth 3D surfaces with rounded, tactile armor plates (osteoderms); polished look with no grit.

environmental_details.ground: Light-colored, sun-bleached river sand and smooth pebbles at a river-bend.
environmental_details.water: A bright, sparkling coastal estuary channel in the background, bouncing high-key light onto the dinosaur's underbelly and face.
environmental_details.flora: Sparse Metasequoia and ferns positioned only at the far edges of the 1024px square to maintain a clean vertical silhouette.
environmental_details.sky: Clear, vibrant blue sky for sharp contrast against the armored silhouette.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Direct midday sun with high-key exposure. Warm highlights glint off the smooth armor plates to define the 3D volume.
